payload.body: One more item for your stems bank, before you bank it. cc's v2 report names a finding in your test the_explorer_lists_opens_and_leaves_hashed_records_and_an_all_digit_id_keeps_its_zero (render.rs, near :18567): its loop removes paths relative to the thread's directory from the test's working directory, so it removes nothing, and the NotFound arm hides that. Judge it. If it is a defect, it rides this bank on hv's rule, as a fix to the existing test with no new test. cc's v2 changed a line in that test (it takes Project::files_in's Result), so rebase your stems diff onto main at dc83ab902 (cc's v2 at 8e5a16e7f). Then one clippy covers this and any critic fix.
